decisions.reason: The client explicitly distinguishes the four-package tier display from full calculator implementation; the deferred calculator remains unchanged.
The source defines package prices by square-footage range, not the display or selection of individually priced services.
Adding square-footage price tiers does not change the one-time pricing model or the removal of monthly and annual tabs.
The package pricing categories are unrelated to gallery category tabs and the optional other-photography area.
The package pricing tiers do not alter gallery hover-animation behavior or scope.
The source changes detailed pricing content but does not change the homepage navigation link or its destination.
The package pricing decision has no effect on the homepage hero image emphasis or blue overlay.
Square-footage package pricing does not affect interactive gallery scrolling.
The source does not change the requirement to provide representative imagery for each service.
The package pricing tiers do not alter the site's image-focused presentation style.
